body:
## Section Summary
Implemented an **Enterprise Indian Textiles & Handloom Heritage Explorer Suite** featuring an interactive HTML/CSS/JS dashboard for exploring India's regional fabrics, weaving techniques, and master artisans — with analytics visualizations and a comprehensive Vitest test suite.

## Related Issue
Fixes #3632

## Type of Change
- [x] Feature
- [ ] Bug Fix
- [x] UI/UX Improvement
- [x] Performance Optimization
- [x] Documentation
- [x] Testing

## Changes Implemented
- Created Textiles Heritage Dashboard HTML (`frontend/indian-textiles-handloom-heritage/index.html`) — 292 lines
- Created Glassmorphic Dashboard CSS (`frontend/indian-textiles-handloom-heritage/style.css`) — 757 lines
- Created Textile Engine (`frontend/indian-textiles-handloom-heritage/textile-engine.js`) — 665 lines
- Created Vitest Unit Test Suite (`tests/unit/textile-engine.test.mjs`) — 600 lines

**Total: 2,314 lines of code**

## Technical Details
### Frontend
HTML5, Vanilla CSS, and JavaScript dashboard with:
- Glassmorphic dark-mode UI with animated weave-pattern hero
- Interactive Fabrics Gallery (14 regional fabrics with material/origin/features)
- Weaving Techniques section (12 techniques: weaving, dyeing, embroidery, printing)
- Master Artisans Database (12 artisans with Padma/National awards)
- Analytics Dashboard with bar charts, material/tradition breakdowns, and heritage timeline
- Global search with multi-term fuzzy matching
- Responsive design with CSS Grid, mobile breakpoints at 768px and 480px
- WCAG 2.1 AA compliant color contrast and keyboard accessibility

### Engine
`TextileEngine` class provides:
- Class-based models: `RegionalFabric`, `WeavingTechnique`, `MasterArtisan`
- Filtering by material, category, specialty
- Multi-term fuzzy search across all text fields
- Sorting by name, origin, and period
- Analytics: state distribution, material breakdown, technique categories, timeline
- State management with reset capability

### Testing
- `tests/unit/textile-engine.test.mjs` — 71 tests covering all engine methods, models, filters, analytics, and render functions
